wave: TOKYO PRIORITY D RANKED NEXT PREFLIGHT 3
phase: Bounded metadata reranking and current/current-linked first-party evidence preflight only
scopeBoundary: The remaining unresearched Tokyo Priority-D inventory was reranked from repository metadata alone under the established performance-oriented rule, and current/current-linked first-party evidence was checked for the top five ranked candidates in order, including tokyo-official-0861 シアターグリーン〔BASE THEATER〕 as an ordinary pool member. Research stopped at the five-candidate ceiling before reaching three ADOPTs. No two-pass transcription, source or range authoring, production integration, generated artifact, fingerprint, or production-total change was made.
policyBasis: ADOPT requires current/current-linked first-party issuer evidence that fixes, without inference, one representative configuration with a complete issuer-numbered seat set, issuer-defined row/block/floor/category ownership, a configuration boundary, and the treatment of accessibility, removable, and alternative configurations, so that an independent two-pass transcription can reproduce it losslessly. DEFER covers a missing or incomplete printed ID set or an unsupported configuration definition. HARD-CASE DEFER is reserved for an otherwise complete numbered chart whose issuer subtotal or accessibility relation alone remains unreconciled. Capacity fitting, invented seat IDs, geometry-derived ownership, configuration mixing, assigning IDs to unnumbered wheelchair spaces, and arbitrary deletion of printed IDs for accessibility reasons are prohibited.
performanceOrientedRankingRule: Dedicated theater, concert hall, live-event hall, or auditorium with continuing stage, theatre, live, or concert use and likely assigned-ticket sales.
Civic/public halls with explicit performance use.
Recreation, multipurpose, meeting, and conference spaces.

existingDispositionsExcluded.method: Every inventoryId, its venueSourceId, and its facility-space identity were checked against data/venue-inventory/tokyo.json, data/venue-sources, and every prior formal venue report before ranking; none of the named records, and no other blocked/production record, was reopened or re-audited. tokyo-official-0861 シアターグリーン〔BASE THEATER〕 was included in the pool at the user's explicit direction and judged independently on its own current issuer evidence, not on its produced siblings' dispositions.

metadataReranking.inputsUsedForRanking: data/venue-inventory/tokyo.json only (priority, researchStatus, venueSourceId, eligibility, officialDisplayName, category, capacity, officialFacilityUrl, discoveryUrlRaw). No Web research informed the ranking.
metadataReranking.candidatePool: 969 Tokyo Priority-D inventory records reduce to 812 with researchStatus not-started or source-located and venueSourceId null (5 fewer than the prior preflight's 817, reflecting that preflight's own ADOPT/DEFER/HARD-CASE-DEFER closures); 279 of those carry an officialFacilityUrl or discoveryUrlRaw.
metadataReranking.tier1Screen: 20 of the 279 carry a dedicated performance identity in the normalized display name (劇場 / シアター / THEATER / 能楽堂 / 音楽堂 / ライブ / live-house brands). One of the 20, tokyo-official-0460 シアター H, was excluded before ranking: its facility name, city (品川区), and officialFacilityUrl (theater-h.jp) are the identical facility-space as the already-produced tokyo-coverage-theater-h (theater-h-standard, current 座席図 704 mapped / 747 published), so it is not a distinct unresearched candidate. The remaining 19 tier-1 records were ordered by the established tie-break: source-located plus likely-eligible plus a direct operator URL plus a recorded capacity outranks not-started plus needs-research plus a null capacity; within each group, larger recorded capacity was used as a secondary tie-break.
metadataReranking.selectedFive: tokyo-official-0861 シアターグリーン〔BASE THEATER〕 (70, source-located/likely-eligible group), tokyo-official-0893 シアター・バビロンの流れのほとりにて (50, source-located/likely-eligible group), tokyo-official-0818 西巣鴨音楽堂 (20, source-located/likely-eligible group), tokyo-official-0635 ユーロライブ (178, not-started/needs-research group), tokyo-official-0813 一般財団法人杉並能楽堂 (150, not-started/needs-research group).
metadataReranking.tier1NotSelected: Within the not-started/needs-research group, ranked below the selected 0635 and 0813 by descending capacity: tokyo-official-1155 グスタフスタジオ〔シアターグスタフ〕 (130), tokyo-official-0688 国立能楽堂〔研修能舞台〕 (100, a distinct training-stage space from produced sibling tokyo-official-0687 能舞台 / national-noh-theatre-standard), tokyo-official-0210 シアターウィング (60), tokyo-official-0800 Live Spot Terra 西荻窪 (60), and the remaining null-capacity tier-1 records (0535, 0589, 0590, 0718, 0742, 0764, 0765, 0769, 0881, 1002). None of these were opened.
metadataReranking.tiers2and3NotSelected: Civic performance halls and recreation/multipurpose/meeting spaces rank below tier 1 and were not opened by this preflight.

facilitySpaceDuplicateCheck.method: Each selected inventoryId, its venueSourceId, and its facility-space identity (facility name, space name, city, officialFacilityUrl) were checked against data/venue-sources, the complete Tokyo inventory, and every prior formal venue report before research.
facilitySpaceDuplicateCheck.result: All five selected records had venueSourceId null and no prior formal disposition. tokyo-official-0861 〔BASE THEATER〕 was confirmed as a distinct facility-space from produced siblings tokyo-official-0859 〔BIG TREE THEATER〕 (theater-green-big-tree-standard) and tokyo-official-0860 〔BOX in BOX THEATER〕 (theater-green-box-in-box-standard); it was judged solely on its own current BASE THEATER facility page, not inherited from either sibling's ADOPT/PRODUCTION status. tokyo-official-0460 シアター H was identified as a duplicate facility-space of already-produced tokyo-coverage-theater-h and excluded from the ranked pool before research began (see metadataReranking.tier1Screen); no research time was spent on it and it was not adjudicated.
facilitySpaceDuplicateCheck.mandatoryExclusionsHonored: All eight DEFER and three HARD-CASE DEFER records listed in existingDispositionsExcluded were excluded from the pool and were neither reopened nor re-audited.

researchOrder.venue: シアターグリーン〔BASE THEATER〕
researchOrder.selectionReason: Metadata-only rerank: dedicated theatre identity, source-located, likely-eligible, direct operator URL, recorded capacity 70; included in the pool at the user's explicit direction rather than excluded because of produced siblings BIG TREE/BOX in BOX THEATER.

officialSources.role: current operator BASE THEATER facility page, seat-count statement, and direct 客席図面/舞台図面/断面図/照明仕込図面 links
current-linked issuer 客席配置図 (seating arrangement diagram)

researchOrder.currentness: Current: the facility page links a 2026-05-dated 照明仕込図面 (basetheater_light_202604.pdf) for the same currently operating theatre group as produced siblings BIG TREE THEATER and BOX in BOX THEATER.
researchOrder.selectedRepresentativeConfiguration: Not defined by the issuer as a numbered configuration. The facility page states 座席数「70席〜」 and explicitly discloses 「現在、席番表示はありません」 (no seat-number display at present); the linked diagram is the only seating drawing.
researchOrder.numberedSeatEvidence: Absent. The 客席配置図 (basetheater_capacity2.pdf) draws seven tiered platform rows of chair blocks at stepped heights (1FL±0 through 1FL+1030) and a separate 車椅子席 (wheelchair seating) area, labelled only with step-height offsets and a single total 「BASE THEATER 70席」; no row letters, no per-chair seat numbers, and no block IDs are printed anywhere on the diagram.
researchOrder.issuerOwnershipSubtotalPublishedCapacity: The facility page and the diagram agree on a single total of 70 seats, but neither publishes any numbered ownership set to which that total could correspond.
researchOrder.accessibilityRemovableMultiConfiguration: The diagram marks a 車椅子席 area by location only, with no seat ID and no stated replacement/conversion relation to any numbered position (there are no numbered positions). No alternative configuration is published.
researchOrder.reason: No current issuer-numbered seat set exists; the operator's own current text states there is currently no seat-number display, and the linked diagram shows only unnumbered tiered chair blocks and a total. This is not a hard case because complete issuer-numbered material is absent, and it is judged independently of produced siblings BIG TREE/BOX in BOX THEATER, whose own current diagrams do print complete numbered sets.

researchOrder.selectionReason: Metadata-only rerank: dedicated theatre identity, source-located, likely-eligible, direct operator URL, recorded capacity 50.

The current-linked portal page is dated 2022-01-19 and states a differing capacity (定員48名) from the inventory's recorded 50, and additional third-party listings found by search state 50; no source of any currentness publishes a seat chart.

researchOrder.accessibilityRemovableMultiConfiguration: No source located an accessibility statement, a removable-seat notation, or a fixed alternative configuration; the venue is consistently described as fully flexible.
researchOrder.reason: No current issuer-numbered seat set or fixed representative configuration exists, and the issuer's own site cannot currently be verified as current/current-linked evidence at all. This is not a hard case because complete issuer-numbered material is absent.

researchOrder.selectionReason: Metadata-only rerank: dedicated live-event hall identity (ライブ), not-started/needs-research, recorded capacity 178 (highest in the not-started/needs-research tier-1 group).

officialSources.role: current operator access/venue-info page; direct fetch required curl due to a WebFetch TLS handshake failure, and the page was read successfully
current-linked issuer 座席表 (seat chart) image, linked directly from the access page
current operator facility-rental page confirming 席数178席（うち2席は補助席） and pointing to the access-page seat chart

researchOrder.currentness: Current: both the access and rental pages are live operator pages for an actively operating comedy/live venue (定期的な落語会「シブラク」とコントライブ「渋谷コントセンター」を開催), and the seat-chart image itself carries a 2023-07 update note for two specific seats, indicating the chart is maintained, not a stale artifact.
researchOrder.selectedRepresentativeConfiguration: The issuer's single 座席表 image is the only published seating layout; no alternative configuration is published.
researchOrder.numberedSeatEvidence: Complete. The chart prints every row A through M in issuer-drawn blocks: rows A-K each print left block 1-4, centre block 5-12, and right block 13-15 (15 per row, 11 rows = 165); row L prints only centre 5-12 and right 13-15, with no left block (11 seats); row M prints only right 13-14, with no left or centre block (2 seats). Every row letter is printed adjacent to each of its own blocks. The independently summed total is 165 + 11 + 2 = 178.
researchOrder.issuerOwnershipSubtotalPublishedCapacity: The chart states 「178席」 at the bottom and the rental page states 席数：178席（うち2席は補助席）; the independently summed printed total of 178 matches exactly.
researchOrder.accessibilityRemovableMultiConfiguration: No wheelchair icon or space is marked on the chart. The chart itself notes 「2023年7月中旬よりM-13、14は補助席仕様となります」 (from mid-July 2023, M-13 and M-14 become auxiliary/supplementary seats), matching the rental page's 「うち2席は補助席」; both printed IDs (M-13, M-14) remain on the chart as a seat-type disclosure, not a deletion. No alternative configuration is published.
researchOrder.reason: Current official issuer evidence fixes one representative configuration, a complete printed ID set across three clearly bounded blocks per row, issuer row/block ownership legible from each row letter's placement beside its own blocks, the configuration boundary, and the treatment of the two auxiliary-seat positions as a disclosure rather than a range change, and the independently summed printed total matches the issuer's own 178-seat subtotal exactly, so an independent two-pass transcription can reproduce it losslessly without invented IDs, geometry-derived ownership, or configuration mixing.
researchOrder.nextTwoPassRequirements: Independently reread every printed ID, block boundary, and gap in rows A through M from the current 座席表 image (eurolive.jp/access/img/eurolive_seat.jpg); compare the issuer's 178 total only after both passes; retain M-13 and M-14 as ordinary printed IDs with the auxiliary-seat (補助席) disclosure as metadata; do not infer a wheelchair position or any additional configuration.
